87	## 1. Reliability Diagram（校准图）
88	
89	**用途**：显示模型 confidence bin vs accuracy，对角线 = 完美校准。
90	
91	```python
92	def plot_reliability_diagram(confidences, accuracies, n_bins=10,
93	                              label='', color='#0072B2',
94	                              title='Reliability Diagram',
95	                              outpath='reliability.pdf'):
96	    """
97	    confidences, accuracies: 各样本的 confidence 和 binary correct (0/1)
98	    """
99	    bin_edges = np.linspace(0, 1, n_bins + 1)
100	    bin_accs, bin_confs, bin_counts = [], [], []
101	
102	    for i in range(n_bins):
103	        lo, hi = bin_edges[i], bin_edges[i+1]
104	        mask = (confidences >= lo) & (confidences < hi)
105	        if mask.sum() > 0:
106	            bin_accs.append(accuracies[mask].mean())
107	            bin_confs.append(confidences[mask].mean())
108	            bin_counts.append(mask.sum())
109	        else:
110	            bin_accs.append(float('nan'))
111	            bin_confs.append((lo + hi) / 2)
112	            bin_counts.append(0)
113	
114	    bin_accs = np.array(bin_accs)
115	    bin_confs = np.array(bin_confs)
116	
117	    fig, (ax_main, ax_hist) = plt.subplots(
118	        2, 1, figsize=(4, 4.5), gridspec_kw={'height_ratios': [3, 1]},
119	        sharex=True
120	    )
121	
122	    # 主图：gaps
123	    ax_main.bar(bin_edges[:-1], bin_accs, width=1/n_bins, align='edge',
124	                color=color, alpha=0.7, label='Accuracy', zorder=2)
125	    ax_main.bar(bin_edges[:-1], bin_confs - bin_accs, width=1/n_bins, align='edge',
126	                bottom=bin_accs, color='red', alpha=0.3, label='Gap', zorder=2)
127	    ax_main.plot([0, 1], [0, 1], 'k--', linewidth=1, zorder=3, label='Perfect')
128	    ax_main.set_xlim(0, 1); ax_main.set_ylim(0, 1)
129	    ax_main.set_ylabel('Accuracy')
130	    ax_main.set_title(title)
131	    ax_main.legend(loc='upper left', fontsize=9)
132	    ax_main.grid(True, alpha=0.3, zorder=1)
133	
134	    # ECE annotation
135	    ece = np.nansum(np.array(bin_counts) / sum(bin_counts) *
136	                    np.abs(bin_accs - bin_confs))
137	    ax_main.text(0.98, 0.02, f'ECE={ece:.3f}', transform=ax_main.transAxes,
138	                 ha='right', va='bottom', fontsize=9,
139	                 bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.3', facecolor='white', alpha=0.8))
140	
141	    # 直方图（样本密度）
142	    ax_hist.bar(bin_edges[:-1], bin_counts, width=1/n_bins, align='edge',
143	                color=color, alpha=0.5)
144	    ax_hist.set_ylabel('Count', fontsize=9)
145	    ax_hist.set_xlabel('Confidence')
146	
147	    plt.tight_layout()
148	    plt.savefig(outpath)
149	    plt.close()
150	    print(f'Saved: {outpath}')
151	```

172	## 2. ECE Heatmap（方法 × 数据集 ΔECE）
173	
174	**用途**：Main Results Table 的可视化版本，颜色 = ΔECE（红=恶化，蓝=改善）。
175	
176	```python
177	def plot_ece_heatmap(delta_ece_matrix, methods, datasets,
178	                     title='ΔECE Heatmap (vs FP16)',
179	                     outpath='ece_heatmap.pdf'):
180	    """
181	    delta_ece_matrix: shape (n_methods, n_datasets), 正=ECE 恶化, 负=改善
182	    """
183	    import matplotlib.colors as mcolors
184	
185	    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(len(datasets) * 1.2, len(methods) * 0.8 + 1))
186	
187	    # 发散色图（中心=0, 红=恶化, 蓝=改善）
188	    vmax = np.nanmax(np.abs(delta_ece_matrix))
189	    norm = mcolors.TwoSlopeNorm(vmin=-vmax, vcenter=0, vmax=vmax)
190	    cmap = plt.cm.RdBu_r
191	
192	    im = ax.imshow(delta_ece_matrix, cmap=cmap, norm=norm, aspect='auto')
193	
194	    # 数值标注
195	    for i in range(len(methods)):
196	        for j in range(len(datasets)):
197	            val = delta_ece_matrix[i, j]
198	            if not np.isnan(val):
199	                color = 'white' if abs(val) > vmax * 0.6 else 'black'
200	                sign = '+' if val > 0 else ''
201	                ax.text(j, i, f'{sign}{val:.1%}', ha='center', va='center',
202	                        fontsize=9, color=color, fontweight='bold')
203	
204	    ax.set_xticks(range(len(datasets)))
205	    ax.set_yticks(range(len(methods)))
206	    ax.set_xticklabels(datasets, rotation=30, ha='right')
207	    ax.set_yticklabels(methods)
208	    ax.set_title(title)
209	
210	    cbar = plt.colorbar(im, ax=ax, fraction=0.046, pad=0.04)
211	    cbar.set_label('ΔECE (quantized − FP16)')
212	    cbar.ax.axhline(0, color='k', linewidth=0.8)
213	
214	    plt.tight_layout()
215	    plt.savefig(outpath)
216	    plt.close()
217	    print(f'Saved: {outpath}')
218	```

368	### Pattern E：Wilson Binomial CI
369	
370	```python
371	def wilson_ci(p, n, z=1.96):
372	    if n == 0: return 0, 0
373	    denom = 1 + z**2 / n
374	    center = (p + z**2 / (2*n)) / denom
375	    half = z * np.sqrt((p*(1-p) + z**2/(4*n)) / n) / denom
376	    return max(0, center - half), min(1, center + half)
377	
378	# 用法
379	lo, hi = wilson_ci(accuracy, n)
380	ax.errorbar(x, accuracy*100, yerr=[[accuracy*100 - lo*100], [hi*100 - accuracy*100]],
381	            fmt='o', capsize=4, capthick=0.8, elinewidth=0.8,
382	            markeredgecolor='white', markeredgewidth=1.0)
383	```

## 1. Reliability Diagram（校准图）

**用途**：显示模型 confidence bin vs accuracy，对角线 = 完美校准。

```python
def plot_reliability_diagram(confidences, accuracies, n_bins=10,
                              label='', color='#0072B2',
                              title='Reliability Diagram',
                              outpath='reliability.pdf'):
    """
    confidences, accuracies: 各样本的 confidence 和 binary correct (0/1)
    """
    bin_edges = np.linspace(0, 1, n_bins + 1)
    bin_accs, bin_confs, bin_counts = [], [], []

    for i in range(n_bins):
        lo, hi = bin_edges[i], bin_edges[i+1]
        mask = (confidences >= lo) & (confidences < hi)
        if mask.sum() > 0:
            bin_accs.append(accuracies[mask].mean())
            bin_confs.append(confidences[mask].mean())
            bin_counts.append(mask.sum())
        else:
            bin_accs.append(float('nan'))
            bin_confs.append((lo + hi) / 2)
            bin_counts.append(0)

    bin_accs = np.array(bin_accs)
    bin_confs = np.array(bin_confs)

    fig, (ax_main, ax_hist) = plt.subplots(
        2, 1, figsize=(4, 4.5), gridspec_kw={'height_ratios': [3, 1]},
        sharex=True
    )

    # 主图：gaps
    ax_main.bar(bin_edges[:-1], bin_accs, width=1/n_bins, align='edge',
                color=color, alpha=0.7, label='Accuracy', zorder=2)
    ax_main.bar(bin_edges[:-1], bin_confs - bin_accs, width=1/n_bins, align='edge',
                bottom=bin_accs, color='red', alpha=0.3, label='Gap', zorder=2)
    ax_main.plot([0, 1], [0, 1], 'k--', linewidth=1, zorder=3, label='Perfect')
    ax_main.set_xlim(0, 1); ax_main.set_ylim(0, 1)
    ax_main.set_ylabel('Accuracy')
    ax_main.set_title(title)
    ax_main.legend(loc='upper left', fontsize=9)
    ax_main.grid(True, alpha=0.3, zorder=1)

    # ECE annotation
    ece = np.nansum(np.array(bin_counts) / sum(bin_counts) *
                    np.abs(bin_accs - bin_confs))
    ax_main.text(0.98, 0.02, f'ECE={ece:.3f}', transform=ax_main.transAxes,
                 ha='right', va='bottom', fontsize=9,
                 bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.3', facecolor='white', alpha=0.8))

    # 直方图（样本密度）
    ax_hist.bar(bin_edges[:-1], bin_counts, width=1/n_bins, align='edge',
                color=color, alpha=0.5)
    ax_hist.set_ylabel('Count', fontsize=9)
    ax_hist.set_xlabel('Confidence')

    plt.tight_layout()
    plt.savefig(outpath)
    plt.close()
    print(f'Saved: {outpath}')
```

## 2. ECE Heatmap（方法 × 数据集 ΔECE）

**用途**：Main Results Table 的可视化版本，颜色 = ΔECE（红=恶化，蓝=改善）。

```python
def plot_ece_heatmap(delta_ece_matrix, methods, datasets,
                     title='ΔECE Heatmap (vs FP16)',
                     outpath='ece_heatmap.pdf'):
    """
    delta_ece_matrix: shape (n_methods, n_datasets), 正=ECE 恶化, 负=改善
    """
    import matplotlib.colors as mcolors

    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(len(datasets) * 1.2, len(methods) * 0.8 + 1))

    # 发散色图（中心=0, 红=恶化, 蓝=改善）
    vmax = np.nanmax(np.abs(delta_ece_matrix))
    norm = mcolors.TwoSlopeNorm(vmin=-vmax, vcenter=0, vmax=vmax)
    cmap = plt.cm.RdBu_r

    im = ax.imshow(delta_ece_matrix, cmap=cmap, norm=norm, aspect='auto')

    # 数值标注
    for i in range(len(methods)):
        for j in range(len(datasets)):
            val = delta_ece_matrix[i, j]
            if not np.isnan(val):
                color = 'white' if abs(val) > vmax * 0.6 else 'black'
                sign = '+' if val > 0 else ''
                ax.text(j, i, f'{sign}{val:.1%}', ha='center', va='center',
                        fontsize=9, color=color, fontweight='bold')

    ax.set_xticks(range(len(datasets)))
    ax.set_yticks(range(len(methods)))
    ax.set_xticklabels(datasets, rotation=30, ha='right')
    ax.set_yticklabels(methods)
    ax.set_title(title)

    cbar = plt.colorbar(im, ax=ax, fraction=0.046, pad=0.04)
    cbar.set_label('ΔECE (quantized − FP16)')
    cbar.ax.axhline(0, color='k', linewidth=0.8)

    plt.tight_layout()
    plt.savefig(outpath)
    plt.close()
    print(f'Saved: {outpath}')
```

def plot_tstar_scatter(tstar_data, outpath='tstar_scatter.pdf'):

                color='gray', zorder=1)

    model_colors = [COLORS.get(m.split('-')[0].lower(), '#333333') for m in MODELS]

    plt.tight_layout()
    plt.savefig(outpath)
    plt.close()
    print(f'Saved: {outpath}')

### Pattern E：Wilson Binomial CI

```python
def wilson_ci(p, n, z=1.96):
    if n == 0: return 0, 0
    denom = 1 + z**2 / n
    center = (p + z**2 / (2*n)) / denom
    half = z * np.sqrt((p*(1-p) + z**2/(4*n)) / n) / denom
    return max(0, center - half), min(1, center + half)

# 用法
lo, hi = wilson_ci(accuracy, n)
ax.errorbar(x, accuracy*100, yerr=[[accuracy*100 - lo*100], [hi*100 - accuracy*100]],
            fmt='o', capsize=4, capthick=0.8, elinewidth=0.8,
            markeredgecolor='white', markeredgewidth=1.0)
```

### Pattern I：Broken axis（异常值或对数 0）

```python

              clip_on=False, linewidth=0.6)

### Pattern J：Path-effect 文字描边

t.set_path_effects([pe.withStroke(linewidth=2.5, foreground='white')])

### Pattern K：Concept curve（合成轨迹建立直觉）

trajectory = baseline * (1 - np.cos(np.pi * x)) / 2
ax.plot(x, trajectory, color='#0072B2', linewidth=2,
        solid_capstyle='round', label='Theoretical trajectory')

# 关键节点用 insight 标注

            xytext=(0.7, final_y - 5), color='#388E3C',
            fontstyle='italic', fontsize=9,
            arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color='#388E3C', lw=0.8))
```

### Pattern L：Forest Plot（meta-analysis 风格）

# 3-column GridSpec: label | CI plot | inline stats
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(7, 3.5))
gs = fig.add_gridspec(1, 3, width_ratios=[0.8, 2, 1.2], wspace=0.1)
ax_label = fig.add_subplot(gs[0]); ax_label.axis('off')

# 等价带（半透明 axvspan）

# 每行：dot + horizontal CI line

                         alpha=alpha, linestyle=linestyle, zorder=3)
    ax.add_patch(box)
    if label:
        ax.text(x + w/2, y + h/2, label, ha='center', va='center',
                fontsize=fontsize, color=textcolor, zorder=4, fontweight='bold')

def draw_arrow(ax, x1, y1, x2, y2, color='black', style='->', lw=1.0, connectionstyle='arc3,rad=0'):
    arrow = FancyArrowPatch((x1, y1), (x2, y2),
                            arrowstyle=style, color=color,
                            linewidth=lw, connectionstyle=connectionstyle,
                            mutation_scale=10, zorder=5)
    ax.add_patch(arrow)

# ============================================================
# Figure
# ============================================================
fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 3, figsize=(14, 4),
                         gridspec_kw={'width_ratios': [1.1, 1.0, 0.9], 'wspace': 0.08})

for ax in axes:
    ax.axis('off')
    ax.set_xlim(0, 10)
    ax.set_ylim(0, 10)

# ============================================================
# Panel A: VLA Sequence and Readout
# ============================================================
ax = axes[0]
ax.set_title('(a) VLA sequence structure', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold', pad=8)

# Token blocks
bw, bh = 0.65, 0.8
y_tokens = 5.5
gap = 0.12

# Image tokens (3 blocks)
img_xs = [0.5, 0.5 + bw + gap, 0.5 + 2*(bw + gap)]
for x in img_xs:
    rounded_rect(ax, x, y_tokens, bw, bh, C_BLUE, fontsize=6)
ax.text(img_xs[0], y_tokens + bh + 0.25, 'Image tokens', fontsize=8, color=C_BLUE, fontweight='bold')

# Instruction tokens (3 blocks)
inst_start = img_xs[-1] + bw + gap * 3
inst_xs = [inst_start, inst_start + bw + gap, inst_start + 2*(bw + gap)]
for x in inst_xs:
    rounded_rect(ax, x, y_tokens, bw, bh, C_GREEN, fontsize=6)
ax.text(inst_xs[0], y_tokens + bh + 0.25, 'Instruction tokens', fontsize=8, color=C_GREEN, fontweight='bold')

# Readout token
ro_x = inst_xs[-1] + bw + gap * 3
rounded_rect(ax, ro_x, y_tokens, bw, bh, C_ORANGE, 'R', fontsize=9)
ax.text(ro_x + bw/2, y_tokens + bh + 0.25, 'Readout', fontsize=8, color=C_ORANGE, ha='center', fontweight='bold')

# Action head
ah_x = ro_x + bw + gap * 3
rounded_rect(ax, ah_x, y_tokens, bw * 1.1, bh, C_RED, 'Act', fontsize=8)
ax.text(ah_x + bw*0.55, y_tokens + bh + 0.25, 'Action\nhead', fontsize=7, color=C_RED, ha='center', fontweight='bold', linespacing=0.85)

# Causal mask arc: image cannot attend to instruction
arc_y = y_tokens + bh + 0.7
draw_arrow(ax, img_xs[1] + bw/2, arc_y + 0.15, inst_xs[1] + bw/2, arc_y + 0.15,
           color=C_LGRAY, style='->', lw=1.2, connectionstyle='arc3,rad=-0.4')
ax.text((img_xs[1] + inst_xs[1]) / 2 + bw/2, arc_y + 1.3,
        'cannot attend\nto instruction', fontsize=7, ha='center', color=C_GRAY,
        fontstyle='italic', linespacing=0.9)
ax.plot([(img_xs[1] + inst_xs[1]) / 2 + bw/2 - 0.1, (img_xs[1] + inst_xs[1]) / 2 + bw/2 + 0.1],
        [arc_y + 1.05, arc_y + 0.85], color='red', lw=1.5, zorder=6)
ax.plot([(img_xs[1] + inst_xs[1]) / 2 + bw/2 + 0.1, (img_xs[1] + inst_xs[1]) / 2 + bw/2 - 0.1],
        [arc_y + 1.05, arc_y + 0.85], color='red', lw=1.5, zorder=6)

# Readout attends to all context
draw_arrow(ax, ro_x + bw/2, y_tokens, inst_xs[0] + bw/2, y_tokens,
           color=C_ORANGE, style='->', lw=1.0, connectionstyle='arc3,rad=0.5')
draw_arrow(ax, ro_x + bw/2, y_tokens, img_xs[1] + bw/2, y_tokens,
           color=C_ORANGE, style='->', lw=1.0, connectionstyle='arc3,rad=0.6')
ax.text((img_xs[1] + ro_x) / 2 + bw/2, y_tokens - 1.3,
        'attends to all context', fontsize=7, ha='center', color=C_ORANGE,
        fontstyle='italic')

# Extraction points
def dashed_box(ax, x, y, w, h, label, color):
    box = FancyBboxPatch((x, y), w, h, boxstyle="round,pad=0.02",
                         facecolor='none', edgecolor=color, linewidth=1.0,
                         linestyle='--', alpha=0.9, zorder=3)
    ax.add_patch(box)
    ax.text(x + w/2, y - 0.3, label, ha='center', va='top', fontsize=7,
            color=color, fontstyle='italic')

# image_mean extraction
dashed_box(ax, img_xs[0] - 0.08, y_tokens - 0.1, (img_xs[-1] + bw) - img_xs[0] + 0.16, bh + 0.2,
           'image_mean', C_BLUE)

# readout extraction
dashed_box(ax, ro_x - 0.08, y_tokens - 0.1, bw + 0.16, bh + 0.2,
           'readout', C_ORANGE)

# Arrow from readout to action head
draw_arrow(ax, ro_x + bw + 0.05, y_tokens + bh/2, ah_x - 0.05, y_tokens + bh/2,
           color=C_GRAY, style='->', lw=1.2)


# ============================================================
# Panel B: Three Analyses
# ============================================================
ax = axes[1]
ax.set_title('(b) Three analysis methods', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold', pad=8)

# --- Row 1: Layer-wise action probes ---
row1_y = 7.8
ax.text(0.3, row1_y + 0.7, 'Layer-wise action probes', fontsize=8, fontweight='bold', color='black')

# Layer stack (3 stacked rectangles)
layer_colors = ['#d4e6f1', '#a9cce3', '#7fb3d8']
for i, c in enumerate(layer_colors):
    rounded_rect(ax, 0.5, row1_y - i * 0.5 - 0.1, 1.5, 0.45, c, f'L{i+1}', fontsize=7, textcolor=C_GRAY)

draw_arrow(ax, 2.2, row1_y - 0.35, 3.0, row1_y - 0.35, color='black', style='->', lw=1.0)

# Probe box
rounded_rect(ax, 3.1, row1_y - 0.6, 1.5, 0.6, '#EAECEE', 'Probe', fontsize=8, textcolor='black')

draw_arrow(ax, 4.8, row1_y - 0.35, 5.6, row1_y - 0.35, color='black', style='->', lw=1.0)

# Action output
rounded_rect(ax, 5.7, row1_y - 0.6, 2.0, 0.6, '#fadbd8', '7-DoF action', fontsize=8, textcolor=C_RED)

# R² label
ax.text(8.3, row1_y - 0.1, 'R²', fontsize=9, fontweight='bold', color=C_RED,
        bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.15', facecolor='white', edgecolor=C_RED, linewidth=0.8))

# --- Row 2: Counterfactual perturbation ---
row2_y = 5.0
ax.text(0.3, row2_y + 0.8, 'Counterfactual perturbation', fontsize=8, fontweight='bold', color='black')

# Correct instruction (struck through)
rounded_rect(ax, 0.5, row2_y - 0.05, 2.2, 0.55, '#d5f5e3', 'correct instr.', fontsize=7, textcolor=C_GREEN)
ax.plot([0.6, 2.6], [row2_y + 0.22, row2_y + 0.22], color='red', lw=1.5, zorder=6)

# Replacement options
repl_labels = ['∅ empty', '✕ wrong', '⟲ shuffle', '≈ paraph.']
repl_colors = [C_LGRAY, C_RED, C_ORANGE, C_SKY]
for i, (lab, col) in enumerate(zip(repl_labels, repl_colors)):
    rx = 3.2 + i * 1.5
    rounded_rect(ax, rx, row2_y - 0.05, 1.3, 0.55, col, lab, fontsize=6.5, alpha=0.6, textcolor='black')

# Arrow to delta action
draw_arrow(ax, 8.7, row2_y + 0.22, 9.2, row2_y + 0.22, color='black', style='->', lw=1.0)
ax.text(9.4, row2_y + 0.22, 'Δaction', fontsize=8, ha='center', va='center',
        fontweight='bold', color=C_RED)

# --- Row 3: L1 attention profiling ---
row3_y = 2.3
ax.text(0.3, row3_y + 0.8, 'L1 attention profiling', fontsize=8, fontweight='bold', color='black')

# Simplified attention matrix (4x4 grid)
grid_x, grid_y = 0.6, row3_y - 0.5
cell = 0.45
attn_vals = np.array([
    [0.8, 0.2, 0.0, 0.0],
    [0.3, 0.7, 0.0, 0.0],
    [0.4, 0.3, 0.6, 0.0],
    [0.25, 0.35, 0.3, 0.5],
])
for i in range(4):
    for j in range(4):
        if j <= i:
            color_val = plt.cm.Blues(attn_vals[i, j])
            rect = plt.Rectangle((grid_x + j * cell, grid_y + (3 - i) * cell),
                                  cell, cell, facecolor=color_val,
                                  edgecolor='white', linewidth=0.5, zorder=3)
            ax.add_patch(rect)
        else:
            rect = plt.Rectangle((grid_x + j * cell, grid_y + (3 - i) * cell),
                                  cell, cell, facecolor='#f5f5f5',
                                  edgecolor='white', linewidth=0.5, zorder=3)
            ax.add_patch(rect)

# Row labels for the matrix
row_labels_m = ['img', 'img', 'inst', 'ro']
for i, lab in enumerate(row_labels_m):
    ax.text(grid_x - 0.15, grid_y + (3 - i) * cell + cell/2, lab,
            fontsize=5.5, ha='right', va='center', color=C_GRAY)

# Attention breakdown annotations
ann_x = 3.0
rounded_rect(ax, ann_x, row3_y + 0.1, 2.8, 0.45, '#d6eaf8', 'readout → instruction', fontsize=7, textcolor=C_BLUE)
rounded_rect(ax, ann_x, row3_y - 0.55, 2.8, 0.45, '#fdebd0', 'readout → image', fontsize=7, textcolor=C_ORANGE)

ax.text(6.1, row3_y + 0.33, 'vs', fontsize=8, ha='center', va='center', color=C_GRAY, fontstyle='italic')

# bracket
ax.annotate('', xy=(6.5, row3_y + 0.55), xytext=(6.5, row3_y - 0.55),
            arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='-', color=C_GRAY, lw=1.0,
                           connectionstyle='arc3,rad=0'))
# curly brace approx
ax.text(6.9, row3_y, 'attention\nratio', fontsize=7, ha='left', va='center',
        color=C_GRAY, fontstyle='italic', linespacing=0.9)


# ============================================================
# Panel C: Claim Structure
# ============================================================
ax = axes[2]
ax.set_title('(c) Finding classification', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold', pad=8)

findings = [
    ('Exit collapse\n(ΔR² > 0.10)', 'Training-\nassociated', C_BLUE),
    ('CF sensitivity\n(d ≥ 0.45)', 'Action-\nlinked', C_GREEN),
    ('L1 instruction\nattention', 'Inherited\nprior', C_ORANGE),
]

for i, (finding, label, color) in enumerate(findings):
    row_y = 7.5 - i * 2.8

    # Finding box (left)
    rounded_rect(ax, 0.3, row_y - 0.4, 3.8, 1.1, '#f8f9fa', finding,
                 fontsize=8, textcolor='black', edgecolor=C_GRAY)

    # Dashed arrow
    ax.annotate('', xy=(7.0, row_y + 0.15), xytext=(4.3, row_y + 0.15),
                arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color=C_GRAY, lw=1.2,
                               linestyle='--'))

    # Classification label (right)
    rounded_rect(ax, 7.0, row_y - 0.3, 2.7, 0.95, color, label,
                 fontsize=8, alpha=0.8)

# Save
# ============================================================
outpath = '/root/vla-ssd/paper_figures/fig_overview.pdf'

plt.savefig(outpath.replace('.pdf', '.png'), format='png')

print(f'Saved: {outpath}')
